source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Hydrogen" (ChemSep index 902, CAS 1333-74-0). Molecular weight, normal boiling point, Tc, Pc and acentric factor as given; standard liquid density: the saturated liquid at Tr = 0.7 (eq. 105, at the eq. 101 vapour pressure), because Tc lies below 288.7 K and no 60 F liquid exists; ideal-gas Cp eq. 16 (A=3994.325, B=-48.69006, C=10.36209, D=-0.000340144, E=1.960333e-7; data 80..1500 K) fitted by least squares as shifted_polynomial_5 over 80..900 K (34 points), largest deviation 1.456 % at 80.0 K, 0.415 % over 298.15..900 K; viscosity tables and freezing data in their entries. Imported by tools/compound-import.

fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the ideal-gas Cp fit range, from max(ChemSep Cp data start, triple point) to 900 K; below it Cp is held and integrated, with a notice (a data-range end, never a validity floor). 100 Pa..2000000 Pa as the bundled light ends: PR78 from ChemSep critical constants, not qualified above that.
